Moss Cocoon Vigil.name: Moss Cocoon Vigil
Moss Cocoon Vigil.description: The user wraps a gravely injured or dying person in a breathable bed of living moss and flowering vines for the rest of the scene. While the bed has light and water and the user keeps a hand on its roots, the patient cannot die from their wounds and slowly mends internal bleeding, deep burns and broken bones over the scene. The user cannot move away and pays extreme stamina from their own reserves. Strain: severe.
